title: Sustainable management of whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) in vegetables using entomopathogenic fungi, Isaria farinosa: Characterization, efficacy, insecticide compatibility with molecular docking insights.
authors: Manjunath, M; Kodandaram, M H; Divekar, Pratap A; Gouri, Vinita; Karkute, Suhas G; Venkataravanappa, V; Rai, A B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白粉虱生物防治真菌Isaria farinosa的杀虫活性及Pr1A蛋白酶与昆虫蜕皮激素受体的蛋白-蛋白对接，对象为昆虫蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Whiteflies are major sap-sucking pests causing significant economic losses worldwide. Excessive reliance on chemical insecticides has resulted in resistance development and adverse effects on non-target organisms as well as on environment. Entomopathogenic fungi (EPF) represent promising ecofriendly alternatives for sustainable pest management. In the present study, an EPF associated with natural epizootics of whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) infesting eggplant was characterized and evaluated under in-vitro conditions for its biocontrol potential. Morphological and molecular studies revealed that, the fungus isolated from infected whitefly is Isaria farinosa. Further, in vitro bioassays confirmed significant insecticidal activity, with 62.28-82.06% adult whitefly mortality after 96 h after treatment at different conidial concentrations. EPF, I. farinosa was found compatible with several insecticides, including cyantraniliprole, sulfoxaflor, flupyridifurone, flonicamid, spiromesifen, difenthiuron, imidacloprid, thiamethoxam, and acetamiprid, used for control of B. tabaci. To explore the molecular basis of pathogenicity, a subtilisin-like protease (Pr1A) associated with cuticle degradation was identified through in silico analysis. The Pr1A sequence was analyzed and its 3D structure was predicted. Protein-protein docking analysis revealed strong interaction between Pr1A and the ecdysone receptor (EcR) of B. tabaci (DeltaG = - 11.2 kcal/mol), suggesting possible interference with insect hormonal regulation. Additionally, molecular docking of the fungal metabolite Beauvericin with EcR showed higher binding affinity (- 14.88 kcal/mol) than standard insecticides, indicating its potential role in insecticidal activity. Overall, the findings demonstrate that I. farinosa is an effective biocontrol agent with strong bio-efficacy, compatible with chemical insecticides, and has potential for integration into IPM programs for sustainable management of whiteflies in vegetable crops.
abstract_zh: 粉虱是主要的吸汁性害虫，在全球范围内造成重大经济损失。过度依赖化学杀虫剂已导致抗药性发展，并对非靶标生物及环境产生不利影响。昆虫病原真菌（entomopathogenic fungi, EPF）代表了可持续害虫管理的环保替代方案。本研究对一种与茄子上的粉虱（Bemisia tabaci）自然流行病相关的EPF进行了表征，并在体外条件下评估了其生物防治潜力。形态学和分子研究表明，从感染粉虱中分离的真菌为粉虱棒束孢（Isaria farinosa）。进一步，体外生物测定证实了显著的杀虫活性，在不同分生孢子浓度处理后96小时，成虫粉虱死亡率达62.28%-82.06%。EPF，即I. farinosa，被发现与多种用于防治B. tabaci的杀虫剂兼容，包括氰虫酰胺（cyantraniliprole）、氟啶虫胺腈（sulfoxaflor）、氟吡呋喃酮（flupyridifurone）、氟啶虫酰胺（flonicamid）、螺螨酯（spiromesifen）、丁醚脲（difenthiuron）、吡虫啉（imidacloprid）、噻虫嗪（thiamethoxam）和啶虫脒（acetamiprid）。为探索致病性的分子基础，通过计算机模拟分析鉴定了一种与角质层降解相关的枯草杆菌蛋白酶样蛋白酶（Pr1A）。对Pr1A序列进行了分析，并预测了其三维结构。蛋白质-蛋白质对接分析揭示了Pr1A与B. tabaci蜕皮激素受体（ecdysone receptor, EcR）之间的强相互作用（DeltaG = -11.2 kcal/mol），表明可能干扰昆虫激素调节。此外，真菌代谢物白僵菌素（Beauvericin）与EcR的分子对接显示，其结合亲和力（-14.88 kcal/mol）高于标准杀虫剂，表明其在杀虫活性中的潜在作用。总体而言，研究结果表明，I. farinosa是一种有效的生物防治剂，具有强生物效能，与化学杀虫剂兼容，并有望整合到IPM计划中，用于蔬菜作物粉虱的可持续管理。
